title: Error messages, batch 1 — the backup row as a full error

steps.path: Settings → Backup & Sync → a failed backup's warning → Retry
steps.headline: A failed backup upload now shows an error under its row, with Retry and Report bug.
steps.changed: The message is the same error block the rest of the app uses. Retry uploads again. Report bug opens the ticket screen with the error already attached. A skipped upload (another backup was running) offers Retry only, since nothing went wrong.
steps.notice: You can act on a failed upload right where it happened, instead of reading a label.
steps.risk: The block stays under the row until you upload again, even if a later automatic backup succeeds.
